tvShow.name: Law & Order Toronto: Criminal Intent
tvShow.overview: An elite squad of detectives investigate high-profile crime and corruption in metro Toronto.

episodes.name: The Key to the Castle
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the disappearance of a crypto investor when he vanishes on Lake Ontario, along with hundreds of millions of his clients' dollars.

episodes.name: Good Neighbours
episodes.overview: A shooting at a condo building leads Graff and Bateman to a twenty-year-old cold case that they must solve in order to catch the killer.

episodes.name: The Real Eve
episodes.overview: When a beloved art professor, Eve Kinwood, is killed, the team must use her art to find the Real Eve and her killer.

episodes.name: Crack Reporter
episodes.overview: A stabbing on a crowded transit walkway throws the detectives into the middle of a heated mayoral race as they investigate the murder of a local journalist.

episodes.name: Bleeding Heart
episodes.overview: When a murder leads Graff and Bateman to a global crime syndicate, they must weave through a complex maze of criminals and victims to find the killer.

episodes.name: Minnow and the Shark
episodes.overview: The death of an executive at a major grocery chain sends our detectives into the cutthroat business of selling food and corporate corruption.

episodes.name: The Sound of Silence
episodes.overview: The discovery of a young woman's remains leads our detectives to the toxic workplace from which she was wrongfully dismissed.

episodes.name: Boys Will Be Boys
episodes.overview: When a local hockey star is found dead on the ice, Graff and Bateman must untangle a hazing scandal that led to the player's suspension days before his death.

episodes.name: Three Points
episodes.overview: The death of a prominent rapper-turned-producer sends Graff and Bateman on the tail of a frenzied serial killer at large in the city.

episodes.name: Cul-de-Sac
episodes.overview: The neighbours of a respected defence attorney become the prime suspects in her murder.

episodes.name: White Squirrel City
episodes.overview: When an unhoused man is stabbed to death in a downtown park, Graff and Bateman are called to investigate as attention turns to his various neighbours.

episodes.name: Digital Lipstick
episodes.overview: A stabbing in the PATH leads Graff and Bateman to one of the most scandalous data breaches in Toronto's history.

episodes.name: Fool's Gold
episodes.overview: When an airport worker is found dead of an apparent suicide, Graff and Bateman quickly deduce he has been murdered and may be responsible for a crime of his own.

episodes.name: Hoggs Hollow
episodes.overview: The team is called to investigate when a young wife is killed in her Hoggs Hollow home, and they uncover a secret hidden within the home and the police department.

episodes.name: Face Value
episodes.overview: A well-liked couple is murdered at their place of business, and while all clues point to a robbery, Graff and Bateman soon discover the murder was a targeted hit.

episodes.name: Disposable People
episodes.overview: The death of a prison inmate takes Graff and Bateman to a maximum-security detention centre to investigate.

episodes.name: The Man in the Stadium
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman are called into the Rogers Centre when a famous Canadian stand-up comic drops dead during a rehearsal on stage.

episodes.name: Canadian Dream
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate when a prominent tech CEO is shot to death in a parking lot alongside an unlucky young delivery driver who happened to be cycling by.

episodes.name: Bitter Pill
episodes.overview: When a billionaire pharmaceutical CEO and his philanthropist wife are found dead in their home, Graff and Bateman are called to investigate.

episodes.name: Tango Romeo
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the death of a seemingly unremarkable middle-aged travel agent when he is found dead outside his split-level house in Mimico.

episodes.name: Skin Deep
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman are called to investigate when an aspiring model is found dead in a landfill during Toronto's Fashion Week.

episodes.name: WAGMI
episodes.overview: When a body is found hanging in a tree, Graff and Bateman are called to investigate the death of a reclusive math tutor.

episodes.name: Uncertain Justice
episodes.overview: The team is brought in to investigate when a mother convicted of infanticide is found dead in a motel bathroom after being released on an appeal.

episodes.name: Forget Me Not
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman are called to investigate, when a beloved resident at a retirement home is found dead of exposure, frozen to death in a nearby park.

episodes.name: Up To Snuff
episodes.overview: When a genuine snuff film is aired at a local film festival, Graff and Bateman are asked to investigate.

episodes.name: Family Meal
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the death of a high-flying corporate consultant, who lives for facts and numbers.

episodes.name: Whole Lotta Love
episodes.overview: When a promising student is found stabbed to death on her university campus, Graff and Bateman are called in to investigate her murder.

episodes.name: The Winning Bid
episodes.overview: A stabbing at a skatepark sends Graff and Bateman into the intricate web of Toronto real estate scams.

episodes.name: Lost & Unfound
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman are called in to investigate when the body of a handyman is found on a Rosedale walking trail.

episodes.name: XOXO
episodes.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the death of a beloved politician with a troubled past.
